_about: M2 DCF inputs for Target Ship 1 (MR product tanker, built 2012, age 14) on the base date 22 May 2026. Every figure was published on or before that date, except the price tested (reported 7 Jul 2026), which is used only as the price checked, never in a value.

tce_year1_usd_day.source: Broker weekly MR 1-year time-charter estimate, 13 May 2026 (stand-in for an FFA curve); one-page table, MR IMO3 row, 1-year column (no page numbers)

tce_year2_usd_day.source: Derived: 2 x broker 2-year estimate (24,500, 13 May 2026) - 1-year estimate (30,000). A 2-year charter pays one flat rate for both years starting now, so 24,500 is the average of years 1 and 2

tce_year3_usd_day.source: Judgement: halfway between year 2 and the long-run TCE, (19,000 + 16,000) / 2; the only 3-year quote is for eco/scrubber ships

tce_long_run_usd_day.source: Listed MR owner (Ardmore Shipping) median TCE 2015-2025, rounded; also sets the sale price. Pages: 2015-2017 in 20-F FY2017 p. 4; 2018-2019 in 20-F FY2019 p. 4; 2020-2025 in the full-year results releases, operating-data table

earning_days.source: Ardmore on-hire 99.3-99.9% (362-364 days), less an allowance for age; 20-F FY2017 p. 4 and 20-F FY2019 p. 4, On-hire utilization row

opex_usd_day.source: Ardmore MR operating cost per day, FY2025; FY2025 results release, operating-data table (FY2023 figure: FY2024 release)

opex_growth.source: Compound growth of Ardmore MR opex 2023-2025: (7,654 / 7,170)^(1/2) - 1

survey_year.source: Special survey due April 2027 = year 1; then every 5 years

survey_cost_musd.source: Top of Ardmore's $1.3-1.8m dry-dock estimate (third special survey); Ardmore 20-F FY2025 p. 18

drydock_days.source: Scorpio Tankers actual 23.6-31.3 days per dry-dock; Scorpio 20-F FY2025 p. 77

ets_musd_year.source: Assumption: charterer carries EU ETS under BIMCO's ETS clause

hold_years.source: Model choice: sold at age 19, before the survey at 20

economic_life_years.source: Ardmore and Scorpio depreciation policy; Ardmore 20-F FY2025 p. 71, Scorpio 20-F FY2025 p. F-18

lightweight_t.source: Proxy: a sister design from the same yard (2010, 51,745 dwt); the ship's own figure is not published

demolition_usd_ldt.source: Tanker demolition price, Bangladesh, broker weekly report, 22 May 2026, p. 7

risk_free.source: US Treasury 10-year par yield, 22 May 2026, 22 May 2026 row, 10 Yr column (web table, no page numbers)

beta.source: Damodaran, levered beta, US 'Shipbuilding & Marine' (8 firms), January 2026 (web table, no page numbers)

beta_unlevered.source: Same row, unlevered beta (for re-levering tests)

equity_risk_premium.source: Damodaran implied equity risk premium, 1 May 2026 (monthly spreadsheet, 1 May 2026 row)

cost_of_debt.source: SOFR 3.55% (22 May 2026) + 1.80% loan margin (Ardmore credit facility, July 2025); no tax (tonnage tax); margin: Ardmore 20-F FY2025 p. 70

debt_share.source: D/E 22.55% from the same Damodaran row: 22.55 / 122.55 (web table, no page numbers)

tce_history_low3_usd_day.source: Scenario lever (bear): Ardmore MR TCE, average of its three lowest years 2015-2025 (2018, 2021, 2017)

tce_history_avg_usd_day.source: Scenario lever (bull): Ardmore MR TCE, average 2015-2025
